installed_timeline_api_evidence.usage_doc_fact: Timeline state changes are applied in the next frame; an immediate is_playing() query observes the prior committed state.
installed_timeline_api_evidence.python_stub_fact: Timeline.commit() applies all pending state changes and invokes callbacks; commit_silently() applies pending changes without callbacks.
installed_timeline_api_evidence.d351_attempt2_behavior: The repair calls pause() up to three times and immediately queries is_playing(), but calls neither a Kit frame update nor Timeline.commit().
installed_timeline_api_evidence.evidence_bounded_cause: The pause requests remained pending, so the immediate PLAY observations do not show that pause() was ignored; they show that the pending timeline state was never applied before the contract query.
